def lift(node, destination):
    cloned = copy.deepcopy(node)
    if isinstance(cloned, ast.FunctionDef):
        # Static methods become ordinary free functions for direct surface invocation.
        cloned.decorator_list = []
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[cloned], type_ignores=[])),
                 "<MCP-source-AST>", "exec"), destination)

        lift(node, ns)
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in ("atr_window", "oi_context"):

    if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "ResearchV2Core4h":

    def __init__(self):
        self.time = 200 * BAR
        self.LINE = "STATIC_AUDIT"
        self.START, self.FINISH = 0, 1000 * BAR
        self.ACTIVE_WINDOWS = None
        self.FORCE_BOUNDARIES = ()
        self.MAX_HOLD_BARS = 42
        self.TARGET_MODE = "none"
        self.REWARD_MULTIPLE = 3.
        self.STOP_MULTIPLIER = 2.

        self.OI_LAG_BARS = 0

        self.is_close = False
        self.is_long = True

        self.fee_rate = .00045
        self.vars = {"context": {"atr": {"value": 2.}}}

        self.requests = []
        self.managed = []
        self.logs = []
        self.open_hooks = 0

    def _entry_window(self, now):
        return methods["_entry_window"](self, now)

    def request_exit(self, reason):
        return methods["request_exit"](self, reason)

    def liquidate(self):
        # Keep is_open True deliberately: test duplicate requests before an engine ack.
        self.requests.append(dict(time=self.time, reason=self.vars.get("exit_reason")))

    def manage_position(self, atr):
        self.managed.append(atr)

    def _log_json(self, label, payload):
        self.logs.append(dict(label=label, payload=payload))

    def _target(self, price, direction, distance, features):
        return methods["_target"](self, price, direction, distance, features)

    def _target_valid(self, target, price, direction):
        return methods["_target_valid"](target, price, direction)

    def _bucket(self, month, direction):
        return ns["_bucket"](self, month, direction)

    def on_v3_open(self):
        self.open_hooks += 1

    def features(self, candles, now, atr):
        # A zero-direction stub prevents entries; this test addresses lifecycle, not alpha.
        return dict(valid=True, direction=0, details={}, reason="no_setup")
